# Closest-result comparison

| Work | Object | What it establishes | Difference from this paper |
|---|---|---|---|
| Nguyen--Teh--Wells 2020 | Functors comparing gauge formulations | Surplus structure may be needed for locality/richness | This paper tracks multiple property channels and theorem-backed recovery across nonexact, indexed limits |
| De Haro--Butterfield 2018 | Model triples and duality | Exact isomorphism schema plus interpretation | This paper focuses on irreversible/approximate arrows and recovery obligations, not duality |
| BFV 2003; Fewster 2015 | Functorial locally covariant QFT | Local covariance and criteria for same physics across spacetimes | This paper compares descriptions across regulator, scale, quotient, limit, and spectral reconstruction |
| Koberinski--Fraser 2023 | RG variants in EFT practice | Domain-specific epistemic roles of full and semigroup RG | This paper turns loss and recovery into claim-level proof certificates and applies them to constructive QFT |
| North 2026 | Perspicuous physical representation | Some formulations better display physical structure | This paper asks when a property is *proved to survive* a transformation and supplies a uniform spectral theorem |
| Osterwalder--Schrader 1973/1975 | Euclidean Green functions | Reconstruction of a Hilbert-space QFT under axioms | Used as one theorem-backed recovery arrow; not generalized or reproved |

The formal recovery-to-spectrum theorem uses standard positive spectral
analysis.  The publication claim is the integrated proof methodology,
property-profile calculus, and Yang--Mills diagnosis, not discovery of the
spectral theorem itself.
